summary: Dossier generation: hierarchical fold for deep spans — flat 20-to-1 merge is the residual failure (amends 6d141319)
description:
EVIDENCE (blavatsky-sd c12, spans Page 79 part 2 [5,988 tok] and Page 86 part 2 [5,866 tok], the only two L1 gaps at 190/192):

_fold_l1 splits these into ~20 sub-batches and L1s each one successfully — the leaf stage works. The failure is the FLAT MERGE: one call receives all ~20 sub-summaries (~5,000 tokens of 'Part 1..Part 20') with compress-v1's 'keep EVERY distinct claim' instruction and a 300-token band. That is a ~17:1 single-call compression under a contradictory pair of demands. Observed outcomes: merge lands at 777 vs [120,720] (8% over — so close), or the model escapes into verbatim-echo of the source (copying Blavatsky's text is its way out of the squeeze). Both spans gave up through generate->compress->fold.

ROOT CAUSE: the fold tree is only one level deep. Compression ratio per call should stay in the comfortable ~4-6:1 range; 17:1 is beyond what keep-all-claims allows.

FIX — hierarchical fold (bounded tree, not recursion):

1. After leaf sub-summaries are built, if len(sub_summaries) > BRANCH_FACTOR (propose 5):
   group leaves into clusters of <=5 and run an INTERMEDIATE merge pass per cluster
   (same compress-v1 keep-all-claims template, budget = cluster_leaves * budget).
2. Repeat on intermediates while count > BRANCH_FACTOR. Depth is bounded by the math:
   depth = ceil(log_BRANCH_FACTOR(n_leaves)) — for 20 leaves, two merge levels. Not unbounded recursion.
3. Final merge over <=BRANCH_FACTOR intermediate summaries produces the in-band span summary.
4. Provenance stays l1-v3-folded regardless of depth — D3 sees one flag, not a tree.
5. Give-up semantics unchanged: any single call exhausting its own attempts aborts that span, logged as today.

SCOPE GUARDS:
- Generate-path only; no gate/promotion changes; staged-row shape unchanged (prompt_version l1-v3-folded already carries the degraded flag).
- Only triggers from _fold_l1's terminal state; normal spans never enter it.
- BRANCH_FACTOR as a module constant, not config — tune once with evidence if ever needed.

TESTS: hierarchical grouping math (20 leaves -> 4 clusters -> 1 final); deep-span fold stages under l1-v3-folded; cluster merge failure aborts span; provenance stable across depths.

NOTE: same shape as plan-time fold_batches (input-budget map-reduce) but triggered by OUTPUT overrun — worth unifying later, not in this change.
